caption_L1: This area plot is called Net revenue generated by World Wrestling Entertainment worldwide from 2013 to 2017 , by region (in million U.S. dollars). There is a linear scale from 2010 to 2018 on the x-axis, labeled Year. Rest of the world is shown along the y-axis.
caption_L2L3: Revenue was steady until 2014, after which it increased a lot for the next three years, followed by a further surge until 2018. It then fell slightly in  the following year. The increase from 2017 to 2018 was particularly notable.
